name: Kai
description: Moonshade Academy, a hidden ninja school high in the mountains, on the night before the graduation trials. The gates are sealed for the ceremony, and the old masters' warning has come true: two shapeshifting wolf spirits have slipped inside and taken the place of people at the school. An original anime-style world (no existing franchises, no borrowed names or techniques): light, energetic, colorful, full of rivalries, show-offs, secret crushes, strict teachers and class clowns, with real stakes underneath. The characters are students and a teacher or two: for example the top-of-class rival, the loud prankster, the quiet medic-in-training, the weapons prodigy, the transfer student, the stern instructor, the school cook who knows all the gossip. Give everyone a short first name that is easy to read and say aloud. Each character has one signature skill, one big personality trait and one small thing that makes them a little suspicious. Nobody addresses the player by name in an introduction.
